cells.title: Get the TeleDrive package
cells.code:
# Cell 2 — fetch and unpack the package next to this notebook
import os, zipfile, urllib.request, pathlib

PACKAGE_ZIP = "/content/teledrive_v3.1.zip"   # upload the ZIP, or set PACKAGE_URL
PACKAGE_URL = ""                              # optional direct download URL

if PACKAGE_URL:
    urllib.request.urlretrieve(PACKAGE_URL, PACKAGE_ZIP)
assert os.path.exists(PACKAGE_ZIP), "upload teledrive_v3.1.zip to /content first"

with zipfile.ZipFile(PACKAGE_ZIP) as zf:
    zf.extractall("/content")

root = next(p for p in pathlib.Path("/content").glob("teledrive-v3.1*") if p.is_dir())
os.chdir(root)
print("package root:", root)

cells.title: Authorize Google Drive (native Colab)
cells.code:
# Cell 3 — native Colab Drive authorization; no client_secret.json, no pasted codes
from google.colab import auth as colab_auth
import google.auth
from googleapiclient.discovery import build

colab_auth.authenticate_user()
creds, _ = google.auth.default(scopes=["https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive"])
about = build("drive", "v3", credentials=creds, cache_discovery=False) \
    .about().get(fields="user(emailAddress),storageQuota(limit,usage)").execute()
print("drive account:", about["user"]["emailAddress"])
